connector.name: Air Pipe
connector.registryDescription: Build, validate, deploy - HTTP APIs, cron jobs, webhooks and MCP tools - from your AI client.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.airpipe.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.airpipe, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Air Pipe API token as a bearer credential, e.g. 'Bearer <token>'. Create one at https://app.airpipe.io/
